decision.criterion: Strict sign of the frozen six-seed mean_queue differences, without retuning.

primary_analysis.aggregation: equal-weight arithmetic mean over all six frozen seeds
primary_analysis.invalidity_rule: Any missing or invalid cell disables matrix means and decisions; colliding but otherwise valid cells remain included.

limitations: B195 uses 95 additional label groups and is not a same-budget algorithm improvement over A.
The additional labels add time coverage in the same three training seeds rather than new training-seed diversity.
Six outcome-independent evaluation seeds provide an independent fixed-policy check, not a universal performance guarantee.

expanded_data_spaced_no_stay_rigid.description: Uncapped raw proposals first pass threshold and stay filters, then coordinator cooldown. Cooldown-rejected proposals are distinct from all PP decisions. Complete accepted traces verify actual switch spacing.

raw_target_spaced_no_stay_rigid.description: Uncapped raw proposals first pass threshold and stay filters, then coordinator cooldown. Cooldown-rejected proposals are distinct from all PP decisions. Complete accepted traces verify actual switch spacing.

interpretation: All three arms are newly run on the six preselected seeds. Complete colliding runs remain in efficiency means; an invalid cell disables the complete-matrix means and decision. The B195 model uses the expanded training budget.
